mapper.select: /*selectBuyerMdAmAdminNewAgentSearchList*/ SELECT A.COM_NAME_LOC, A.ADD_DATE, A.CONFIRM_DATE, A.COM_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY A, SUPLITMG C WHERE A.BUSINESS_COND = 'S' AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.COM_CODE = C.SUPPLIER(+) AND C.KEP_BUYER_EXIST = 'Y' AND ( C.KEP_BUYER1 =#{st_buyer} OR C.KEP_BUYER2 =#{st_buyer} OR C.KEP_BUYER3 = #{st_buyer} OR C.KEP_BUYER4 =#{st_buyer}) AND A.CONFIRM_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-2),'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY A.CONFIRM_DATE

/*selectBuyerMdAmAgentInfo*/ SELECT MAX(A.COM_NAME_LOC) AS COM_NAME_LOC, MAX(A.IRS_NO) AS IRS_NO, MAX(A.ZIP_CODE) AS ZIP_CODE, MAX(A.ADDRESS_LOC) AS ADDRESS_LOC, MAX(A.CEO_NAME_LOC) AS CEO_NAME_LOC, MAX(A.INDUSTRY_TYPE) AS INDUSTRY_TYPE, MAX(A.BUSINESS_ITEMS) AS BUSINESS_ITEMS, MAX(DECODE(A.COUNTRY_CODE,'KR','Korea, Republic of',A.COUNTRY_CODE)) AS COUNTRY_CODE, MAX(A.CEO_REG_NO) AS CEO_REG_NO, MAX(A.ESTABLISH_DATE) AS ESTABLISH_DATE, MAX(A.TEL_NO) AS TEL_NO, MAX(A.FAX_NO) AS FAX_NO, MAX(A.ADDRESS_LOC) AS ADDRESS_LOC2, MAX(A.HP_ADDRESS) AS HP_ADDRESS, MAX((SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = A.COM_CODE AND USER_TYPE = 'A')) AS SALES_PERSON, MAX((SELECT PHONE_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = A.COM_CODE AND USER_TYPE = 'A')) AS SALES_TEL, MAX((SELECT FAX_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = A.COM_CODE AND USER_TYPE = 'A')) AS SALES_FAX, MAX((SELECT MOBILE_PHONE FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = A.COM_CODE AND USER_TYPE = 'A')) AS SALES_MOBILE, MAX((SELECT EMAIL FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = A.COM_CODE AND USER_TYPE = 'A')) AS SALES_EMAIL, MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE ='M005' AND CODE = C.BANK_CD)) AS BANK, MAX((SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE ='M005' AND CODE = C.BANK_CD)) AS BANK_BRENCH, 0 AS AREA, 0 AS CLERICAL, 0 AS PRODUCTION, 0 AS TOTAL_CNT, '' AS ITMG1_NM, '' AS ITMG2_NM, '' AS ITMG3_NM
FROM ICOMCMPY A, ACNTSUPL C WHERE A.COM_CODE = C.SUPPLIER AND A.COM_CODE = #{st_agent_code} AND A.BUSINESS_COND = 'S' AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R')

/*selectBuyerMdAmAgentPoInfo*/ SELECT SUM(TOT_CNT) AS TOT_CNT, SUM(OK_CNT) AS OK_CNT, BUYER_CODE FROM ( SELECT SUM(A.ITEM_AMT) AS TOT_CNT, 0 AS OK_CNT, A.BUYER AS BUYER_CODE FROM ICOMPODT A, ICOMPOHD C WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND C.STATUS ^= 'D' AND A.STATUS ^= 'D' AND C.PO_CREATE_DATE LIKE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY')||'%' AND C.AGENT =#{st_agent_code} GROUP BY A.BUYER UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS TOT_CNT, COUNT(A.PO_NO) AS OK_CNT, A.BUYER AS BUYER_CODE FROM ICOMPODT A, ICOMPOHD C WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND A.STATUS ^= 'D' AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND C.PO_CREATE_DATE LIKE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY')||'%' AND C.AGENT =#{st_agent_code} GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.PO_NO UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS TOT_CNT, 0 AS OK_CNT, A.BUYER AS BUYER_CODE FROM ICOMPODT A, ICOMPOHD C WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND C.STATUS ^= 'D' AND A.STATUS ^= 'D' AND C.PO_CREATE_DATE LIKE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY')||'%' AND C.AGENT =#{st_agent_code} GROUP BY A.BUYER ) GROUP BY BUYER_CODE

/*selectBuyerMdAmAgentDlvryInfo*/ SELECT SUM(TOT_CNT) AS TOT_CNT, SUM(OK_CNT) AS OK_CNT, BUYER_CODE FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOT_CNT, 0 AS OK_CNT, A.BUYER AS BUYER_CODE FROM ICOMPODT A, ICOMPOHD C WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND C.STATUS ^= 'D' AND A.STATUS ^= 'D' AND A.RD_DATE LIKE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY')||'%' AND C.AGENT =#{st_agent_code} GROUP BY A.BUYER UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS TOT_CNT, COUNT(*) AS OK_CNT, A.BUYER AS BUYER_CODE FROM ICOMPODT A, ICOMPOHD C WHERE A.BUYER =#{st_buyer_code} AND A.STATUS ^= 'D' AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND A.RD_DATE LIKE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY')||'%' AND C.AGENT =#{st_agent_code} AND A.ITEM_QTY <= A.GR_QTY AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMGRDT B WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ= B.PO_SEQ AND B.STATUS ^= 'D' AND A.RD_DATE < B.GR_DATE) GROUP BY A.BUYER UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS TOT_CNT, 0 AS OK_CNT, A.BUYER AS BUYER_CODE FROM ICOMPODT A, ICOMPOHD C WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND C.STATUS ^= 'D' AND A.STATUS ^= 'D' AND A.RD_DATE LIKE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY')||'%' AND C.AGENT = #{st_agent_code} GROUP BY A.BUYER ) GROUP BY BUYER_CODE
